title: assure
description: Starts the assure command line: reads the subcommand and its flags, runs assure record (ST-ASR-CLI01), assure gate change (ST-ASR-CLI02), assure gate release (ST-ASR-CLI03) or assure ledger (ST-ASR-CLI04), and exits with its code: 0 when it did its work or the commit passed, 1 when it refused, record failed or a proof did not pass at the commit, 2 when it was called wrongly, the gate cannot decide or the ledger cannot be built.
